7.6.5 Behaviour in sub-state ETHSM_STATE_ONLINE
[SWS_EthSM_00208] Self transition STATE_ONLINE ⌈If the EthSM statemachine is in state ETHSM_STATE_ONLINE, EthSMWakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is set to TRUE and ComM request COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST, then the controller mode of the corresponding EthIfCtrl shall be requested with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST.⌋
